dedup: own wave011 finite grammar/label-free proposal allocation
mechanism: Existing pair-first screen versus a label-blind seeded uniform order over an identical complete typed AST universe.
prediction: Fixed coarsening can erase useful raw pair distinctions; score ties do not imply zero incremental downstream utility. Opposite literal worlds show no universal proxy guarantee.
nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN: two invented worlds, eight user-query groups/two candidates, one positive group. Twelve same-unit parents, sixty-six oriented subtraction programs; test constant-bin histograms/ties/closure and reversed ordering.
task1_benefit: Isolate allocation benefit from extra legal opportunities/manual inventory and from model representation of an already available interaction.
strong_control: Same grammar/Q/C/fullY/source/time/NULL semantics/model recipe/selection, total-cost ceiling and explicit label-feedback/fit caps. Uniform can use saved screening resources within common caps. B/W eligible controls only in same future context with costs counted.
negative_disposition: Defer if seeded uniform matches, useful pairs are eliminated, or there is no incremental gain against eligible B/W. No feedback expansion by default.
cost: O(N*p^2) all-pair updates; histogram state up to O(p^2*b^2); dense program outputs O(N*p^2). Pay bin fitting/full prerequisite history/auth/NULL closures/spills/all proxy and validation looks/reused feedback/failures/BW controls.
chronology: Strict-past event feature snapshots; mature full labels before screening, fitted bins/proposer available before application. No policy adaptation from revealed October final.

sources.claim: All-pair interaction screen followed by candidate downstream CV, Algorithm3; not fit-free utility oracle
Random search is a natural baseline; no guarantee for this sparse feature-pair pool
